# LawSites

> > LawSites tracks legal technology innovation, products, and industry trends through journalism, interviews, and analysis by Robert Ambrogi.

LawSites is a leading publication covering legal technology, innovation, and the business of law, maintained by legal journalist Robert Ambrogi. The site publishes in-depth interviews with legal tech founders, analyzes emerging trends like AI and unauthorized practice of law, and maintains the LawNext Directory for discovering legal tech solutions.

## Key Topics

- Legal Technology
- AI in Law
- Legal Innovation
- E-Discovery
- Law Firm Software
- Legal Ethics
- Unauthorized Practice of Law
- Access to Justice
- Legal Tech Trends
- Attorney Sanctions
- 2026 Predictions
- Clio
- Everlaw
- Robert Ambrogi
- LawNext Directory

## Core Properties

- [LawSites Homepage](https://www.lawnext.com): Homepage tracking legal tech websites, products, and innovation
- [LawNext Legal Technology Directory](https://directory.lawnext.com): Directory to discover, compare legal tech products with reviews
